notes: PLANNED, NOT YET RUN: parity runs wait for the Harbor team's agreement on agent, model, subset and budget. Plan: Scenario 2 (upstream ships no runner). Original side: harbor_parity/run_parity.py in the fork pixel3user/mlops-bench@harbor-parity (upstream 8f48b68 plus harbor_parity/), following the upstream README protocol (agent gets the task specification and repo/; score = PYTHONPATH=<workspace> python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_f2p.py tests/test_p2p.py) with Claude Code 2.1.326 installed and launched exactly as Harbor's claude-code agent does (same install commands, command line, environment variables, /workspace git baseline, 1 CPU / 2048 MB, 1800 s timeout) and a prompt byte-identical to instruction.md for all 212 tasks. Harbor side: harbor 0.26.0, run_mlops-bench_parity.yaml (claude-code, version 2.1.326, anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5). Model claude-haiku-4-5 on both sides through the same Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Subset: --split parity, 7 tasks per MLOps stage (random.Random(42) over each stage's sorted instance ids), 49 tasks from 25 of 31 repositories. Metrics, per run: task completion rate (share of tasks whose published F2P+P2P tests all pass) and test pass rate (passed scoring tests / published scoring tests, pooled over the run's tasks, as upstream defines 'test pass'). Smoke test 2026-11-26 (1 task per side): identical Claude Code init settings, reward 1.0 on both sides.
